argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='E:\pc-github-relay'
$healthPath=Join-Path $repo '.pc-relay\health.json'
$h=$null
if(Test-Path $healthPath){$h=Get-Content $healthPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json}
$local=(git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$remote=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/agent/pc-github-relay).Trim()
$req=@(git -C $repo ls-tree -r --name-only origin/agent/pc-github-relay -- relay/requests | Where-Object {$_ -like 'relay/requests/*.json'}).Count
$res=@(git -C $repo ls-tree -r --name-only origin/agent/pc-github-relay -- relay/results | Where-Object {$_ -like 'relay/results/*.json'}).Count
$procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -like '*github_relay.py*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*E:\pc-github-relay*'} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId)
[pscustomobject]@{
  health_version=$h.version
  health_pid=$h.pid
  phase=$h.phase
  last_sync_at=$h.last_sync_at
  last_completed_cycle_at=$h.last_completed_cycle_at
  last_request_id=$h.last_request_id
  last_result_id=$h.last_result_id
  health_request_count=$h.request_count
  health_result_count=$h.result_count
  health_backlog=$h.backlog
  reconciliation_required=$h.reconciliation_required
  last_error=$h.last_error
  local_head=$local
  remote_head=$remote
  remote_requests=$req
  remote_results=$res
  remote_backlog=($req-$res)
  matching_processes=$procs
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress

note: Read-only post-restart PC Control health snapshot; distinct from interrupted checker invocation
